title: Flip lift
summary: A lifts toward the camera, flips with a wobble and a sheen, lands as B with an echo; B's parts pop in.
signature: flipLift(a, b, p, { duration, lift, perspective })

params.name: duration
params.description: length of the transition in seconds; springs use it to keep their feel

params.name: lift
params.description: lift toward the camera in px

notes: A lifts toward the camera, flips with a wobble and a sheen across its face, and lands as B with an echo; B's parts pop in after.
Stack A and B in one positioned slot (their parent); give the slot overflow:hidden to keep travel inside it.
Pass the real duration in seconds and call it through p = 1: that is when it hides the layers it made.
when: a card turns over to show its other side
